describe: The image shows what looks like a texture atlas for a sheep model, with several separate pieces laid out on a flat grey background. The large upper area is a cream-white woolly fleece with warm yellow-brown shading and darker tan patches. Smaller pieces sit at the lower part: a brown-black leg, a pinkish-orange hoof or leg, and grey-brown patches with dark spots. Lighting is soft and brightest on the fleece. Keep every piece in place.
